notes.title: BULLET SOUL INFINITE BURST Ver1.2
notes.content:
Today's update includes:
 Changed default sound settings
This should fix sound balance issues.
 Changed default controller settings
This should fix the issue some people had with the analog stick not registering diagonals.
 Fix for mouse cursor displaying in full screen
The mouse cursor will no longer appear in full screen mode.
 

Thanks for all your support of Bullet Soul Infinite Burst!

notes.title: Bullet Soul Infinite Burst Caravan Mode Launch Contest!
notes.content:
http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/29843852/80d90cf40e2fbfad4485261dcf6d1c733543b6c6.png

To celebrate Bullet Soul Infinite Burst coming to Steam, we are holding a Caravan Mode Launch contest!

What is Caravan mode?
Caravan mode is a “score attack” sequence, where you rack up as many points as possible within two minutes.

Rules:
- The contest will run during the first week of the game's release (contest will end 8/6 at 10pm EST)
- To enter your score into the contest, just play Caravan Mode and upload your score OR take a screenshot of the score screen and tweet your screenshot @MagesSteam during the launch week 
-  The highest score for EACH character will receive an official SIGNED Bullet Soul poster!
- The player with the most common digits in a row (222,222,222 for example) will also receive an official Bullet Soul poster signed by the dev!
- Only one prize per person ;)

We put together some Caravan Mode tips  here!
